subject.title: Dashboard: editable notes / todo / markdown widget (stateful)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled stateful notes/todo/markdown dashboard widget after widget write-back lands, or should this live as an external ClawHub/plugin widget?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing dashboard builtin and depends on unlanded widget state, storage, and security decisions that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Keep Open Behind Candidate PR
options.body: Review the write-back stack and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101829, then close this issue only after an accepted implementation lands.

options.title: Move To ClawHub
options.body: Treat notes/todo as an optional widget package once the public dashboard widget APIs are sufficient.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Builtins
options.body: Pause this and related roadmap items until maintainers explicitly sponsor the broader modular dashboard direction.

recommendation.title: Keep Open Behind Candidate PR
recommendation.body: Review the write-back stack and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101829, then close this issue only after an accepted implementation lands.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and bundled dashboard scope decisions.
